{{Quote|Commander, I'm picking up a lot of unusual static. Could be a signal jammer.''"<br />"''It could also be the spires. The Separatists wanted this planet's coral: it makes a great ship-building material. Interfering with communications might be a bonus.|[[Eyeball]] and [[Cody/Legends|Cody]]|<ref name="The Only Good Clanker">{{TCWComicCite|6.26|The Only Good Clanker}}</ref>}}
'''Bogoa''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] covered in spires of durable [[Coral/Legends|coral]], which could be used as [[Starship/Legends|ship]]-building materials. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was under the protection of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Its coral made it a target for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], which [[Battle of Bogoa|battled]] the Galactic Republic for three long days and nights for control of the coral world.
